title: Gröbner–Shirshov bases for representation theory
container-title: Journal of the Korean Mathematical Society
note: Metadata verified 2026-11-23 against the KoreaScience landing page and against [kangleeleeoh2002] ref. [8] (no DOI is registered; free PDF at https://koreascience.or.kr/article/JAKO200011921111015.pdf). Develops Gröbner–Shirshov PAIRS for representations of associative algebras; its worked example is sl_3. [kangleeleeoh2002] Lemma 1.10 quotes its main result (the composition lemma for pairs). It is NOT the source of the Hecke-algebra GS basis — cite [kangleeleeoh2002] Prop. 4.3 for that. Not to be confused with Kang & Lee, J. Algebra 232 (2000) 1–20 (irreducible sl_{n+1}-modules), [kangleeleeoh2002] ref. [9], which is not in this bibliography. Body not read (the PDF host refuses automated fetches).
